mixes.name: Lightweight Railing Mix
mixes.description: Lightweight priority — for railing boxes where weight matters
mixes.notes: Lightest mix. Good general-purpose for flowers.

mixes.name: Moisture-Retentive Greens Mix
mixes.description: Holds moisture well for leafy greens and mint
mixes.notes: Extra compost keeps moisture high for thirsty greens.

mixes.name: Mediterranean Drainage Mix
mixes.notes: Sand and perlite ensure rosemary, lavender, and thyme don't get wet feet.

mixes.name: Rich Tomato & Basil Mix
mixes.description: Rich and moisture-retentive for heavy feeders
mixes.notes: Tomatoes and basil love rich soil. Add slow-release fertilizer at planting.

mixes.name: Medicinal Herb Mix
mixes.notes: Balanced mix. Valerian likes moisture; lavender likes drainage — this splits the difference.

mixes.name: Deep Flower Mix
mixes.description: Well-draining mix for deep flower containers
mixes.notes: Slightly more potting mix for deep pots. Good for lupine's taproot.

mixes.name: Lean Direct-Sow Mix
mixes.description: Lean soil — nasturtium prefers low fertility
mixes.notes: Low fertility on purpose. Rich soil makes nasturtium all leaves, no flowers.
